entries.name: lexytcg
entries.reason: Taken payment for booster boxes and ghosted buyer. Had a website but it's no longer available.

entries.name: cinderace_.collectibles
entries.reason: Conducted Rip and Ship, cancelled it when his brother pulled a Pikachu SR and raffled the SR instead. Only conducts shady raffles and rip/ships without commitment.

entries.name: tcg_gamerz
entries.reason: Instagram deleted and replaced with new account.

entries.name: card_3370
entries.reason: Didn't send cards that were paid for, citing package is lost. Not replying to messages from buyer.

entries.name: charizardexpress
entries.reason: Selling fake cards in the name of real ones.

entries.name: jetta14_eb
entries.reason: Impersonating a seller on eBay to scam people in India.

entries.name: TheCharizardGuy
entries.reason: Did not commit to a deal and backed out of pre-order after order was placed to overseas source, causing loss. Explicit no-cancellation rules were in place.

entries.name: Pokeguy
entries.reason: Did not pay for a slab he bought. Currently owes ₹1,000 as per the deal.

entries.name: Yuvraj Singh
entries.reason: Suspicious deals on sealed products.

entries.name: Biwachannel
entries.reason: Impersonating an eBay seller and trying to scam by sending fake/other seller images.

entries.name: Tushar Krishna
entries.reason: Used another seller's product as bait and scammed a buyer for ₹750.

entries.name: Dev Tiwari / Mew Collectibles
entries.reason: Scammed around 30 people with around ₹7 lakh of stuff. Not responding to calls for refund or shipment and is most likely fled his hometown.

entries.name: One-Stop Vault
entries.reason: Posted another seller's pic of a highly expensive Umbreon VMax card and tried to sell for ₹1.4 lakh without actually having the card in hand.

entries.name: nothing / proghsj
entries.reason: Posting a Mewtwo GX slab and a Charizard card owned by someone else, acting as dropshipper scammer. Impersonating community member Abhay. All accounts deactivated.

entries.name: Mister TCG Shop
entries.reason: Cards were sent for grading with no updates for a long time. Resolved — Mister TCG Shop has since provided updates and timelines for delivery.

entries.name: Ravnoor Singh / Indian TCG
entries.reason: Opened a booster box, kept 2 packs for himself and sold the rest as open box without disclosure. Conducted rip and ship, collected slots, then disappeared. Damaged cards on delivery. Charged ₹20 per toploader after promising freebies. Multiple unresolved complaints.

entries.name: Anish
entries.reason: Reportedly stole cards during a meetup. Denied allegations but offered repayment for confirmed stolen cards. Previous attempt to scam someone for a PSA 10 Latios/Latias GX slab. Deal with caution.

entries.name: Brock TCG
entries.reason: Posting pics of cards being sold by others on Instagram and Discord without their consent, and does not have the cards in hand for sale.

entries.name: 123 ttttt
entries.reason: Fake account created for scamming people. Now deactivated.

entries.name: Rishi
entries.reason: Offered a buyer a card at a discount then offered the same card at different prices to others. Asked buyer to transfer money to another seller as advance. Lied about shipping for a week, deal was eventually called off.

entries.name: That90'sKid
entries.reason: Held an auction for a card he did not have in hand. Posted pictures of the card from tcghub's page claiming he had purchased it.

entries.name: Vedant
entries.reason: Conducted a pre-order round for cards from Japan. Provided no clear timelines and ghosted buyers. All vouches on his profile were from fake accounts.

entries.name: POKETCG999
entries.reason: Tried to scam people by using eBay photos claiming he had a booster box in hand.

entries.name: The PokéCircle
entries.reason: Extremely overpriced items. Selling a booster box worth ~₹18,000 for ₹48,000 citing import duties and freight charges.

entries.name: pikatcgstore_10
entries.reason: Posted a card for ₹1,000, then revised price to ₹1,600 in DMs claiming someone else was willing to pay more.

entries.name: Pranay Tej
entries.reason: Reversed a payment for a rip and ship slot done over a month ago, marking it as a fraud transaction and causing the seller's UPI ID to get blocked.

entries.name: SK Cards
entries.reason: Selling cards from another seller. Asked them to provide timestamped images to dropship cards for profit.

entries.name: Rudra Dev Tiwari
entries.reason: Selling fake cards for the prices of real ones.

entries.name: HypeFly
entries.reason: Selling Pokémon cards at extremely high prices. No vouches from community. Deletes comments critiquing their prices.

entries.name: the_pokemoncatcher
entries.reason: Delayed delivery of a Terrastal Festival Booster Box by 4+ months. Agreed to refund but has not refunded or delivered.

entries.name: Soumitra Gandhi
entries.reason: Multiple instances of delayed deliveries with various excuses. Ghosted buyers and only delivered when publicly called out.

entries.name: The Poké Mystery
entries.reason: Kid attempting to obtain large pre-orders by selling items above market. Proceed with caution on large purchases. Resolved with seller.

entries.name: Rehaan Khan
entries.reason: Unresponsive after receiving payment. Scammed multiple people — one victim was scammed for ₹20,000 and received only regular EX cards in return. Still active in many groups.

entries.name: Elite TCG India
entries.reason: Openly threatens buyers. Scams people from multiple communities. Took orders for booster boxes, collected payment, then revealed he was lexytcg and deactivated the account.

entries.name: Saurav and Aradhya Auctioning Group
entries.reason: Running investment scheme promising 1–1.5% daily return on Pokémon card investments. ₹1,000 investment promised to compound to ₹38,000 — classic Ponzi scheme. WhatsApp: 7976132992.

entries.name: Prateek Sharma
entries.reason: Purchased an item, received the package, then claimed he did not receive the card without providing proof of unboxing. Account ID changed since being added.

entries.name: Gurpreet Bedi
entries.reason: Did not ship out English Pokémon cards priced at ₹9,100. When situation was made public, tried to pay back. Removed from WhatsApp groups.

entries.name: Suhaan
entries.reason: Repeated concerns regarding poor communication during transactions, lack of accountability in deals involving payments, and an uncooperative or dismissive attitude when issues arise.

entries.name: EvoCollects3
entries.reason: Using fake feedbacks to make sales.

entries.name: Worldsports.best
entries.reason: No response after taking money. Matter has since been resolved.

entries.name: Nishant Debramma
entries.reason: Held auctions on Pokeverse group then disappeared. Denied being the person when called. Scammed at least ₹10,000 from 2 individuals.

entries.name: Sagar Chopra / Lavender Town Trading Co.
